cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies who delivered at term (n=726)
finding: In a cohort of nulliparous women at term, those with cervical dilation > 1 cm were significantly more likely to go into labor in the following week.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women at term with cervical dilation greater than 1 cm were significantly more likely to go into labor in the following week.
